display_long_description:
ULTRA HEIGHT 121 BUNDLE takes VR climbing to new heights with 121+ intense challenges across 11 massive worlds. Inspired by Ultra Height: Mist City Climb, this game combines grapple gun action, web-swinging, and extreme flying for a heart-pounding vertical adventure. Master climbing, moving platforms, ziplining, jet rockets, parachute jumps, and gravity-defying stunts. Conquer skyscrapers, cliffs, and futuristic cities as you swing like a superhero and soar through the skies.

🗻 Key Features:

Plank Walking – Conquer extreme heights step by step.

Climbing – Scale skyscrapers, cliffs and impossible structures.

Jet Rocket Flying – Blast through the skies at insane speed.

Grapple Gun Swinging – Swing between towers like a true hero.

Gravity Gun Experiences – Jump and Slow Down Gravity

Hang Glider Flights – Glide across massive open skies.

Parachute Base Jumps – Leap from dizzying heights above the clouds.

Flying Platforms – Jump and traverse floating structures.

Ziplining – Slide across the skyline at high speed.

Mixed Challenges – Combine mechanics in intense vertical trials.

Free Exploration – Roam freely and discover hidden routes.


🗺️ Explore 11 Massive Maps:

Cyber City

Indoor Playground

Outdoor Playground

New Mist City

Rocky Mountains

High Playground

New Sky City

Antenna Isle

Private Island

The Ultra Mall

Sky Bay

⚠️ Warning: Stay above the fog or the game restarts. Don’t look down!
